Our client is a specialist welding and industrial gas supplier serving trade, fabrication, engineering, construction, and industrial customers across the Northern Territory, seeking a professional person to join their sales team in a Front Counter role.

The Opportunity:

  • Serve customers at the front counter
  • Handle counter and phone sales, enquiries and product requests
  • Process customer orders, sales transactions and quotations through SAP/Computer systems
  • Promote and upsell products
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with trade, industrial and welding customers
  • Maintain accurate stock levels
  • Receive, pick, pack and dispatch goods

Requirements to fulfill the role:

  • Previous experience in customer service, including sales, and industry products
  • Good verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong customer service focus
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, team environment
  • Willingness to learn product range
  • Ability to pass a Pre-Employment Medical and Drug and Alcohol Screen
  • Clean National Police Clearance
  • Full, unlimited working rights

How to Apply:

If you want to join a safety-first, friendly team, simply "Apply Now".

job.title: HR Tanker Driver
job.description:
The Opportunity:

Our client is Australia’s largest supplier of Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG), servicing over 350,000 residential, commercial, and industrial customers since 1984. Seeking an experienced HR Tanker Driver to deliver to bulk LPG to commercial clients and service stations across the greater Adelaide region.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Operating tanker vehicles to safely transport and deliver LPG gas in line with dangerous goods and road transport regulations
  • Conducting daily pre-start checks, vehicle inspections, and basic maintenance reporting on trucks and delivery equipment
  • Managing delivery runs and schedules efficiently
  • Completing delivery paperwork, compliance documentation, and customer records accurately

Requirements to fulfill the role:

  • Minimum of 2 years' experience driving HR and tanker-type vehicles
  • Valid HR Truck Driving
  • Dangerous Goods Licence preferred
  • Must be able to provide a Good Driving History Record with minimal offences
  • Physically fit and healthy, being able to run hosing and connections. Able to pass a Pre-Employment Medical and Drug and Alcohol Screen
  • Full “Unrestricted” Working Rights in Australia with residency in proximity to Para Hills West, SA
  • Punctual, reliable, and trustworthy are essential attributes for this role

How to Apply:

If you wish to join a safety proactive team, simply “Apply Now”
